# Kolaboro

> Kolaboro checks off-plan property projects for people buying abroad, before each payment. Every project page shows what the developer published (company, land, permit or licence number, handover date, payment plan, construction status) against official registers and dated sources, with a right of reply. Buyers pay; developers never pay. Today the checks are desk reviews and official-register lookups online, with Sentinel-2 satellite views where we hold them; site visits by local agents are being set up, and escrow is not offered. Desk research covers 878 off-plan projects in 144 markets and 76 countries (1 Nov 2026), 7,572 developer claims tested, each check rated by source (official register, independent source, developer only, contradicted, not published). An automated second check of 485 claims in 50 random projects found a 2.2% error rate among checkable claims (see /corrections/). Prices and what each service includes today: https://kolaboro.com/pricing/.

## Citation assets (data of the day, CC BY 4.0)
- [Every named project, one citation-ready block each](https://kolaboro.com/llms-projects.txt): handover on record, permit number published or not, buyer checks, last checked
- Canonical answers per project in Markdown: https://kolaboro.com/answers/<slug>.md (is it legit, delivery date, permit, developer, buyer reviews, what changed, sources, how to cite); slugs in https://kolaboro.com/api/v1/projects
- [Monthly market data stories](https://kolaboro.com/stories/): delays, dated promises, permits, advertised prices vs registered sales, page changes; each with a CSV and a citation line
- [What changed this month](https://kolaboro.com/changes/): changes between dated, fingerprinted copies of developer pages ([Atom](https://kolaboro.com/changes/feed.atom))
- Embeddable fact card and delivery tracker per project: https://kolaboro.com/embed/p/<slug>/
## Facts
- Prices: Kolaboro pre-purchase check EUR 490; construction monitoring EUR 99 per month; buyer's agent 1% of price, minimum EUR 2,000.
- Agents are never paid by developers. Paying for verification never changes a Trust Score.
- Kolaboro does not currently hold client money and does not give legal or financial advice.
